abstract: Fifty-eight of the 44,698 patients seen at our Department, between 1972 and 1984 had a testicular tumor. The incidence rate was 0.13%. The mean age of these 58 cases was 28.6 years and two peak distributions, one in the 0 to 5 year and another in 26 to 30 year age group were observed. Among them, 54 patients (93.1%) had chief complaints of painless testicular swelling at initial examination. The vast majority of them had unilateral tumors; 28 in the right and 29 in the left. Only one patient had bilateral seminomas. Histologically, 30 of them (51.7%) were seminoma, 8 were embryonal carcinoma (13.8%), 2 were teratoma (3.5%) and the remaining 18 had tumors of double or multiple histological type. Most of the seminomas were treated by a combination of high orchiectomy and radiotherapy, and chemotherapy was done mainly for non-seminomatous cases. The 5-year survival rate calculated by the Kaplan-Meier method was 100% for patients with low stage (I, II) seminomas and 62% for those with non-seminomatous tumors.
abstract_ja: 1972年から1984年までに当科を受診した44,698例のうち、58例（発生率0.13%）が精巣腫瘍であった。これら58例の平均年齢は28.6歳で、0～5歳と26～30歳の2つの年齢ピークが認められた。このうち54例（93.1%）は初診時に無痛性の精巣腫大を主訴としていた。大多数は片側性の腫瘍で、右側28例、左側29例であった。両側性セミノーマは1例のみであった。組織学的には、30例（51.7%）がセミノーマ、8例（13.8%）が胎児性癌、2例（3.5%）が奇形腫、残る18例は複数の組織型を有する腫瘍であった。セミノーマの多くは高位精巣摘除術と放射線療法の併用で治療され、化学療法は主に非セミノーマ症例に行われた。Kaplan-Meier法で算出した5年生存率は、低病期（I、II期）セミノーマで100%、非セミノーマ性腫瘍で62%であった。
